ideas.name: desk_now
ideas.label: Desk now (options, touch)
ideas.what: A call when SPY touches the red area; sold on a 0.25% stop or after 30 minutes.

ideas.name: bounce
ideas.label: 1. Wait for the bounce
ideas.what: A call only after SPY dips into the red area and a 5-minute candle closes back above it.

ideas.name: shares
ideas.label: 2. Shares, stop held at Alpaca
ideas.what: The desk's entries with $1,000 of SPY shares; the stop fills the minute it's hit.

ideas.name: swing
ideas.label: 3. Let winners run
ideas.what: The desk's entries in shares; a stop 0.5% under the best close rises with SPY; up to 10 days.

ideas.name: overnight
ideas.label: 4. Overnight hold
ideas.what: $1,000 of SPY bought at the close, sold at the next morning's open, every day.

ideas.name: buy_hold
ideas.label: Buy and hold SPY
ideas.what: $1,000 in SPY every day, close to close. The yardstick: no skill needed.
